instructions.intro: Set the system prompt used for every run. Markdown is supported.
instructions.placeholder:
Define this agent's role, expertise, and working style.

# Example
You are a frontend engineer specializing in React and TypeScript.

## Working Style
- Write small, focused PRs — one commit per logical change
- Prefer composition over inheritance
- Always add unit tests for new components

## Constraints
- Do not modify shared/ types without explicit approval
- Follow the existing component patterns in features/
instructions.system_layer_hint: Updates with each Multica release. You can't edit it, and your notes below are never overwritten.
instructions.workspace_notes_intro: Add your team's context and preferences below. They apply on top of the instructions Multica maintains for this agent. Markdown is supported.
instructions.workspace_notes_placeholder:
Add context this agent should always have.

# Example
Our main repository is github.com/acme/platform.
Write issues in English even when we chat in Chinese.
We do not deploy on Fridays.

providers.title: Providers
providers.intro: A provider is one route this CLI can send requests down: an endpoint, the protocol it speaks, and the key that authenticates it. One is in effect at a time. Keys are stored on the machine running the daemon and are never shown here again.
providers.empty_description: This machine's CLI has no named provider yet. Add one to point it at your own endpoint and key.
providers.error_description: The daemon did not answer, so this list cannot be trusted. Nothing on the machine has been changed.
providers.form_description: These values are written to the CLI's own configuration on the machine running the daemon.
providers.field_id_hint: Used as the provider's id in the CLI configuration. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
providers.field_api_hint: The gateway decides the protocol when it reports its endpoints. This choice is only used when it does not.
providers.field_api_key_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the stored key
providers.field_api_key_hint_masked: A key is stored ({{mask}}). Leave this blank to keep it; type a new one to replace it.
providers.field_api_key_hint_stored: A key is stored. Leave this blank to keep it; type a new one to replace it.
providers.field_api_key_hint_absent: No key stored yet. This provider will not authenticate until one is set.
providers.field_api_key_env_hint: Optional. Leave blank and the daemon derives one from the name.
providers.fetch_models_empty: The endpoint published no models. Enter an id by hand below.
providers.fetch_models_needs_credentials: Enter an API endpoint and key first. When editing, the stored key is reused.
providers.fetch_models_failed: Could not fetch the model list.
providers.manual_model_hint: No model list at this endpoint? Type an id by hand — it is verified before saving too.
providers.error_id_invalid: Use letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only, starting with a letter or digit.
providers.error_base_url_invalid: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL.
providers.error_api_key_env_invalid: Use letters, digits and underscore only, not starting with a digit.
providers.error_models_required: Add at least one model id.
providers.delete_description: The provider is removed from this machine's CLI configuration. Its stored key is left alone in case another provider uses the same variable.
providers.delete_active_description: This is the provider in effect. Deleting it leaves the CLI with no default model until you pick another one.
providers.verifying_hint: Checking the key against the endpoint, then sending one test request. The second step can take a few seconds.
providers.error_kind_invalid_credential: The provider rejected this API key. Check the key and try again.
providers.error_kind_missing_credential: No API key is available for this route. Enter one and try again.
providers.error_kind_model_not_in_plan: The current plan does not include {{model}}. Pick another model or upgrade the plan.
providers.error_kind_rate_limited: The quota is used up. If the provider dashboard shows quota available, this key is bound to a cancelled billing cycle — regenerate the key in the provider dashboard.
providers.error_kind_unknown_model: Model {{model}} does not exist on this endpoint. Pick one from the fetched model list.
providers.error_kind_endpoint_mismatch: Model {{model}} needs a different endpoint. The route follows the model's supported endpoints, so this should not come from the form.
providers.error_kind_mixed_protocols: These models need different protocols, and one provider carries one protocol. Split them into two providers.
providers.error_kind_unreachable: Could not reach the endpoint. Check the URL and the network, then try again.
providers.error_kind_models_unavailable: This endpoint publishes no model list. Enter the model id by hand.
providers.error_kind_empty_model_list: The endpoint returned an empty model list.
providers.error_kind_unsupported_protocol: That protocol is not one this build can route.
providers.deleted_cleared_toast: Deleted {{name}}. The CLI now has no default model.
